summary.text: Shadows over Innistrad follows Jace Beleren across Innistrad, where Avacyn has finally returned but madness plagues the inhabitants and the forces that once protected humans have been twisted into something dark and strange.
Avacyn turns against humans, and at the Drownyard Jace discovers the cryptoliths pointing to a nexus of redirected leylines and a journal warning of an eldritch moon nearing the plane.
Meanwhile Sorin Markov seeks Olivia Voldaren's help, and Thalia breaks with the church and founds the Order of Saint Traft.
